title: Vegetable Sides and Salads Recipe Roundup
contentHtml:
Vegetable sides bring a much-needed balance to any Thanksgiving Day feast. Explore our best salads and veggie side dishes below.

Vegetables have a tendency to fall by the wayside in the Thanksgiving prep haze, but they're just as deserving of a spot on your plate! We've gathered salads and other vegetable side dishes below into a recipe roundup as you prepare for Turkey Day.

Looking for potatoes dishes? Those recipes are included in our starchy roundup instead, Stuffing, Breads, & Potatoes Recipe Roundup.

Brussels sprouts: Friend or foe?

Thanksgiving Plate Classics: Brussels & Green Beans

Brussels sprouts commonly make an appearance on a Thanksgiving plate. If you feel you haven't cracked the code on maximizing their flavor yet, this recipe leaves them browned and crisp with sweet, nutty flavors coming through: Easy Roasted Brussels Sprouts. 🔗

If you're heating up a deep fryer for or one of many reasons this Thursday, drop some Brussels in there too. Even the kids' table will have no choice but to enjoy them: Fried Brussels Sprouts With Shallots, Honey, and Balsamic Vinegar. 🔗

Another classic is green bean casserole. Much like cranberry sauce, there's no shame in the can game when it comes to this dish. But if you want to make it from scratch, look no further: The Ultimate Homemade Green Bean Casserole. 🔗

If green beans without the casserole is more of your vibe, you can get a little French with it or keep it deeply American with a bacon braise: Bacon-Braised Green Beans. 🔗

And if you want your green beans in a Sichuan style, check out our new recipe infused with zesty flavor: Braised Green Beans with Pickled Mustard Greens. 🔗

One of many make-ahead options!

Salads & Slaws

This make-ahead salad with roasted squash and kale will reduce your holiday stress levels and provide a perfectly seasonal side to round out any plate: Make-Ahead Roasted Squash and Kale Salad With Spiced Nuts, Cranberries, and Maple. 🔗

Keeping with the make-ahead theme, this salad only has two main ingredients but brings pepitas into the mix for some festive fun: Easy Make-Ahead Carrot and Chickpea Salad With Dill and Pumpkin Seeds. 🔗

Now keeping with the chickpea theme, this dense salad is perfect for any vegans that will be joining your table. Roasting the chickpeas concentrates their flavor and provides a nice crispy texture: Roasted-Chickpea and Kale Salad With Sun-Dried Tomato Vinaigrette Recipe. 🔗

Definitely one of the more niche ingredients you might see in a modern recipe, this salad stars the rye berry. If you happen to have a bag of these sitting around: First, comment down below because, seriously, what are the odds? Then get to work making this hearty salad: Rye Berry and Carrot Salad. 🔗

A perfectly wintry salad, this dish contrasts sweet, caramelized pears with punchy blue cheese: Roasted Pear Salad With Endive, Blue Cheese, and Hazelnut. 🔗

You can also keep your vegetable offerings more free-form with a veggie platter. Here's the tips and tricks to assembling the perfect one for any occasion: How to Assemble an Awesome Vegetable Platter. 🔗

Gingery, glazy greatness.

Other Vegetable Side Dishes

Here, simple roasted cauliflower gets dressed up with a Sicilian-inspired vinaigrette. Much like Brussels sprouts, cauliflower benefits from high heat to unlock its roasty, toasty, nutty potential: Roasted Cauliflower With Pine Nut, Raisin, and Caper Vinaigrette. 🔗

To brighten your plate, how about a much-needed gingery kick? This recipe also includes the tips you need to know to make a foolproof glaze: Gingery Glazed Carrots Recipe. 🔗

This recipe puts roast carrots in the spotlight with a posh dressing of crème fraîche: Roasted Carrots With Harissa and Crème Fraîche Recipe. 🔗

Intensely savory, maximum umami. These mushrooms use every trick in the book to amplify their rich flavor: Easy Roasted Mushrooms. 🔗

Similar to the mushrooms above, onions are a great option that can act as an addition to your appetizer plate or a complementary side to your main course, including:

  • Easy Roasted Cipollini Onions Recipe. 🔗

  • Glazed Pearl Onions. 🔗

  • Creamed Pearl Onions. 🔗

This recipe is a Frankenstein-style creation taking different parts of a Thanksgiving plate—Brussels sprouts, green bean casserole, and Hasselback potato gratin—and turning it into a creature that comes to life in its own right: Over-the-Top Creamed Brussels Sprout Gratin Recipe. 🔗

Do any Frienjis serve soup for Thanksgiving? We can't say it's traditional, but can't say we'd judge, either! Especially if it's one of the following perfectly seasonal options:

  • Creamy Cauliflower and Bacon Soup Recipe. 🔗

  • Spicy Carrot and Ginger Soup With Harissa. 🔗

  • Roasted Pumpkin Soup With Brown Butter and Thyme. 🔗
